full_text:
An experimental species of spider was genetically engineered by Klaus and used to guard his base in Vienna, Austria. They had wings and could eat their way through anything. 

== History ==
Klaus created these carnivorous spiders through experimentation. [The Bookshop Hunter] After recovering the power Neverlost, he fed the Sceptre of Nefertiti to them, destroying it in seconds. When the Huntik team found the lift, the swarm of spiders attacked them but were destroyed by Dante Vale's Ignatius. [The Bookshop Hunter]

== Abilities ==
The Spiders were extremely aggressive and could consume an artifact in seconds. They were able to break into magical defense spells such as Overshield but ultimately could not withstand flames.

An experimental species of '''spider''' was genetically engineered by [[Klaus]] and used to guard his [[Klaus' bookshop|base]] in [[Vienna, Austria]]. They had wings and could eat their way through anything. 

== History ==
Klaus created these carnivorous spiders through experimentation. {{source|The Bookshop Hunter}} After recovering the power [[Neverlost]], he fed the [[Sceptre of Nefertiti]] to them, destroying it in seconds. When the Huntik team found the lift, the swarm of spiders attacked them but were destroyed by [[Dante Vale]]'s [[Ignatius]]. {{source|The Bookshop Hunter}}

== Abilities ==
The Spiders were extremely aggressive and could consume an artifact in seconds. They were able to break into magical defense spells such as [[Overshield]] but ultimately could not withstand flames.
